link.title: A Deleted File Can Still Be Alive

entry.summary: TIL: A Deleted File Can Still Be Alive If a process has a file open, deleting it doesn’t free the data — only the directory name goes away. The data (inode) sticks around until every open file descriptor referencing it is closed.
